referenceFidelity.findings: Pale oak bookshelf, true curved central reading niche, books and burgundy carrel wings capture Rapt expansion landmarks. It is a compact reusable interpretation rather than an exact furniture copy.

construction.findings: Real segmented closed arch solids preserve central negative space; rear panels intentionally close seated niches. Side stacks have distinct shelves/books; carrel wings have consistent depth.

readability.findings: Phone framing retains central blue niche, burgundy paired screens and book-filled outside stacks. Wood outline and curved opening identify the unit.

motion.findings: Intentionally static environment ensemble; no rig, animation, root motion or gameplay behavior requested.

secondPass.findings: Repaired initial empty side bays by adding vertical book stacks and narrower seat cushions. Finished export rechecked front/oblique/reverse and phone: arch remains clear, new shelf depth does not cross the carrel wings.

userAcceptance.note: User requested production; no artistic acceptance of this specific revision has been given.

limitations: Research-informed modular interpretation; furniture measurements are inferred, not certified as-built specifications.
